note: What a server sends to put a pet on the field. The header names the pet. A server sends it to clients watching a match.

revisions.note: A client gives the pet its owner's side.

fields.name: owner
fields.note: The unit it belongs to.

fields.name: node
fields.note: Which network node it belongs to.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where it stands, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: atY
fields.note: In height, in world units.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: spellLevel
fields.note: The level of the spell that summoned it, plus one. A client uses it only in some states of the owner, which are not recorded.

fields.name: unused
fields.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

fields.name: damageBonus
fields.note: What is added to the damage it deals.

fields.name: healthBonus
fields.note: What is added to its health.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Its name, padded with zero bytes.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads its art under, padded with zero bytes.

fields.name: skin
fields.note: Which look it wears.

fields.name: effect
fields.note: An effect it carries, padded with zero bytes. A client uses it only in some states of the owner, which are not recorded.

fields.name: clone
fields.note: The unit it copies, or zero.

fields.name: flags

bits.name: copyInventory
bits.note: Set where it copies its owner's items.

bits.name: clearOwnerTarget
bits.note: Set where its owner's target is cleared; a client acts on it only where the owner is its own champion.

fields.note: How it behaves.

fields.name: script
fields.note: The script that drives it, padded with zero bytes.

fields.name: withOwner
fields.note: Not zero, where the owner is a champion, to class the pet with its owner for display. What that changes on screen is not recorded.

revisions.note: A client deletes any object holding the header's id; spawns nothing where it does not know the owner; kills the owner's earlier pet if it lives; makes the pet, replacing its script with script; gives it the owner's seat, its gold going to the owner; and registers it under the header's id and node. spellLevel, duration and effect have no effect.
